title: Compare AI Agents
job_text: Gather publicly available documentation on multiple AI agents. Collect feature comparisons, such as conversational capabilities, knowledge base scope, and integration options. Decide which agents to compare based on relevance and popularity. Create a video summary of the comparisons, highlighting key differences and similarities. Publish the video on YouTube.
what_happened: I created a video comparing the results of testing multiple AI agents, including Grok Bot, Hermes, and OpenClaw, as a way to document and share the differences in their functionality.

evidence.note: Imported from a reply on the X thread tagged for @tryreallybot.
